newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom aims for higher earnings.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom aims for higher earnings.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG said it was confident its 1997 pretax profit will be more than four times its first-quarter result.

Chief finance officer Joachim Kroeske said a quadrupling of the 2.2 billion mark first-quarter figure would be a "negative view." He declined to give a specific forecast, saying Telekom needed room to respond to price reductions by competitors.
Sales in the second half tend to be at least one billion marks higher than the first half due to the higher number of working days, and personnel reductions will also have a positive impact, he said.
